note: AGFC identifies the White River trout tailwater from Bull Shoals Dam to the Highway 58 bridge at Guion. Bull Shoals generates hydropower. This establishes the named river corridor, not current floatability or permission to use every shoreline.

AGFC explains that upstream reservoir conditions govern tailwater releases and directs visitors to generation-condition contacts on the relevant tailwater maps. Preserve generation/rapid-water-change guidance.

AGFC identifies Beaver Dam on the White River and describes the tailwater flowing about 7.5 miles before Table Rock Lake. The mapped itinerary must remain downstream of the dam; the river line is not a dam crossing or a forecast of releases.
